text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend four candidates to City Council for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.

City Council on December 17 and 18, 2024, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Terri Jaffe to the Board of Directors of TO Live, at pleasure of Council, for a term office ending December 20, 2028, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b and 2 to 4 to the report (November 12, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live. Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b and 2 to 4 to the report (November 12, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Board of Directors of TO Live.
